create_image_to_video_pipeline: create a HunyuanSkyreelsImageToVideoPipeline for image-to-video generation using HunyuanVideo transformer
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode text prompts into Llama and CLIP embeddings with prompt template formatting and cropping
prepare_image_latents: prepare image latents by encoding the input image through the VAE and padding with zeros for video frames
run_denoising_inference: run the denoising diffusion loop with true CFG guidance to generate video frames from image latents
decode_video_latents: decode generated video latents through the VAE and postprocess into PIL images or numpy arrays
